Built for busy offices, this scanner is ideal for industries such as finance, healthcare, education, legal services, government, and corporate environments where high-volume document processing is essential.
Fast Scanning for Demanding Workloads
The DS-800WN delivers impressive scanning speeds of up to 50 pages per minute (ppm) and 100 images per minute (ipm) with single-pass duplex scanning. This allows both sides of a document to be captured simultaneously, significantly reducing processing time and improving office efficiency.
With a robust daily duty cycle of up to 8,000 pages, the scanner is designed to handle intensive daily workloads without compromising performance. The integrated 100-sheet Automatic Document Feeder (ADF) further enhances productivity by enabling uninterrupted batch scanning.
Flexible Network Connectivity
Designed for shared office environments, the DS-800WN offers multiple connectivity options including:
USB 3.2 Gen 1×1
Wi-Fi
Wi-Fi Direct
Ethernet LAN
Its integrated network capability allows multiple users to access the scanner across the office, making collaboration and document sharing easier than ever. Users can scan directly to network folders, USB devices, cloud services, FTP servers, and Microsoft SharePoint without requiring a dedicated PC connection.
Standalone Operation with Touchscreen Interface
The scanner features a user-friendly 10.9 cm customizable color LCD touchscreen that allows direct operation from the device itself. Employees can quickly select scan destinations, configure workflows, and manage scanning tasks directly from the touchscreen interface.
This standalone functionality reduces dependency on connected computers and simplifies everyday document management tasks for businesses.
Advanced Scanning Features
The Epson DS-800WN is equipped with intelligent document processing technologies that ensure accurate and professional-quality scans. Key scanning features include:
Automatic de-skew and auto-rotation
Blank page removal
Punch hole removal
Text enhancement
Barcode recognition
Full Zonal OCR
Scan to searchable PDF
Scan to cloud storage
These advanced features help improve document readability, organization, and digital archiving efficiency.

Long paper scanning
